content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 5 TO 7)
ARCHES (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
Circumference, \(C\) , of circle, radius \(r\) . \(C = 2\pi r\)

This task looks at models for the lengths of arches. An arch is the curved part of a tunnel or bridge. Content removed due to copyright restrictions. Engineers use the dimensions of an arch to calculate its strength.
In this task, each arch has: \(\bullet\) width \(w\) metres \(\bullet\) height \(h\) metres \(\bullet\) curved length \(l\) metres.
